comment: labrel RELEVANCE LADDER benchmark — SHARED by labrel0/labrel4/labrel8/labrel16 (ports 1904-1907). One zone, one lamp; physics: Z1Level = 25 + (Z1Light ? 400 : 0). Rank bounds [50,100,300]: lamp off => 25 lux (rank 0), lamp on => 425 lux (rank 3); target is rank 3. The ONLY exogenous condition is the degenerate sun rank 0 (Sunshine is always 0 and has no state slot). Decoy actuators differ per rung (0/4/8/16) but carry NO state slot and NO scenario keys — each lab's setState handler resets every decoy flag to FALSE before applying these fields, so all scenarios start with all decoys OFF (decoys never affect lux; they only add energy cost while ON). Intended optimal routes: scenario 1 (lamp off, rank 0) -> the single action SetZ1Light=ON reaches rank 3; scenario 2 (lamp on, rank 3) -> already at goal, optimal is DO_NOTHING/hold. With only 8 observable states [Z1Level,Z1Light], benchmark and training coverage necessarily coincide — no held-out states exist.
